title: Where ‘Istanbul’ Comes From
sentences: The name Istanbul likely comes from a Greek phrase meaning to the city.
Local Greeks often called Constantinople simply the City.
Heading there, they would say is tin polin, into the city.
Turkish speakers heard it as Istanbul.
The Ottomans used that name, but also Kostantiniyye, the city of Constantine.
Only in 1930 did Turkey make Istanbul the city's only official name.
